verdict.top_defect: Suppression is gated on REUSE_SKIP_SKILLS.get(node_id) being truthy while the 'drafting_skipped_audit_executed' reuse decision is persisted to Tier 4 before that lookup — a node in REUSE_ELIGIBLE_NODES but absent from REUSE_SKIP_SKILLS would record drafting-skipped, pass the reuse run_id escape hatch on that record, and still recompose over stale drafts; latent only, since the two tables currently share keys.

rollup_inconsistency lowercases overall_status (claim_status.py:84,104) but no_unresolved_material_claims compares exactly (criterion_predicates.py:218), so a preseeded section with 'Unresolved' passes gate_10a while the retained canonical_pack_deriver publishes the never-applied declaration as in force

Component suppression is properly enumerated, but the carried-forward drafting-skill skip is still hardcoded name-string matching across three tables never checked against the manifest's resolved skill_ids — an unmatched skip id is a silent no-op, so a skill rename lets the monolithic drafter overwrite the preseeded section while the new audit record falsely claims it was skipped.
